title: oncall: add compact diagnostics helpers + telemetry hints for SLO toolkit
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Add a set of compact diagnostics helper utilities to the incident-bot oncall workflow and small telemetry hint integration for the slo-toolkit. Motivation: oncall messages are noisy and long; responders need short, actionable context snippets (5-7 lines) and a telemetry hint that surfaces the best next diagnostic command. This PR introduces compact context extraction, ranking heuristics for runbook links, telemetry hint API in slo-toolkit, and docs for oncall responders.

What this changes: compact context extractor (incident-bot/src/oncall/helpers_context.py) that returns prioritized context snippets, a small ranking util to order runbook links by signal (matching SLO id, recent pager counts, and keyword overlap), and a telemetry hint provider (slo-toolkit/src/telemetry/hints.py) which surfaces the top diagnostic action for the oncall UI. Added unit tests and minimal docs.

Checklist:
- [x] Compact context extractor implementation
- [x] Runbook ranking heuristics
- [x] Telemetry hint API and integration shim
- [x] Unit tests for helpers and ranking
- [x] Documentation updates for oncall flows
- [x] CI green and e2e validation on staging

Commits (high level):
- feat(oncall): compact context extractor + unit tests
- feat(slo-toolkit): telemetry hint API and integration shim
- test: add tests for context extraction and ranker
- docs: oncall helpers guide and examples

Files changed (high level):
- incident-bot/src/oncall/helpers_context.py  (new) -- compact context extraction and prioritization
- incident-bot/tests/test_helpers_context.py  (new) -- unit tests and edge cases
- slo-toolkit/src/telemetry/hints.py  (new) -- hint provider to suggest next diagnostic step
- incident-bot/docs/oncall-helpers.md  (modified) -- usage and examples for responders
- .github/workflows/incident-bot-ci.yml (modified) -- add test matrix entry for slo-toolkit compatibility

Behavior and performance notes: The extractor aims to be cheap (O(n) over event text) and returns up to 5 snippets with character-limited context windows. Ranking heuristics prefer runbooks with recent pager hits and exact SLO id matches; tie-breakers fall back to token overlap and recency. Telemetry hints are intentionally best-effort and gated behind a flag (ONCALL_HINTS=true) to allow staged rollout.

Review summary:
- Jordan Lee: requested smaller, more focused helper functions and added unit test coverage for boundary conditions. Asked to confirm memory behavior when processing very large event payloads.
- Priya Nair: suggested tightening the default snippet length and exposing a configuration knob for teams to tune context window. Also asked to include a short paragraph in docs about when hints are disabled.
- Samir Gupta: verified SLO id matching logic and recommended adding a quick fallback that suggests generic troubleshooting steps if no runbook match is found.

Author responses and updates:
- Split the main extractor into two helpers per Jordan's suggestion (tokenize_and_trim + rank_snippets). Added a test that feeds a 2MB payload and validated streaming-friendly behavior (uses a sliding window to avoid large allocations).
- Added ONCALL_SNIPPET_MAX_CHARS env var and documented it per Priya's feedback.
- Implemented Samir's fallback suggestion: if no runbook is matched, the hint provider returns a curated list of generic steps (service restart, check recent deploys, check error budget).

CI and checks:
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-tests: pass
- lint (flake8/ESLint): pass after small fixes
- e2e (staging): pass (one flaky run retried and was green)

Merge strategy: squash-and-merge after approvals and green CI.

Release notes: 
- Add compact oncall context helper to incident-bot: extracts prioritized short snippets for oncall responders.
- Add telemetry hint provider to slo-toolkit: surfaces best-effort next-diagnostic suggestions in the oncall UI.

Backporting/rollout: staged feature flag rollout (ONCALL_HINTS) recommended; no immediate backports required.

Notes for operators: The new ranking uses a small in-memory recent-pager-count cache (ttl=5m). If your deployment has tight memory constraints enable the feature flag and set ONCALL_SNIPPET_MAX_CHARS to a lower value (default 1200).

release_notes: - incident-bot: compact context extractor for oncall responders; - slo-toolkit: telemetry hint provider to suggest next diagnostic actions; configurable snippet length via ONCALL_SNIPPET_MAX_CHARS; feature gated by ONCALL_HINTS flag.
notes_for_operators: Feature requires ONCALL_HINTS flag to be enabled. Default snippet max length is 1200 chars; reduce via ONCALL_SNIPPET_MAX_CHARS for low-memory environments. Ranking uses a small recent-pager-count cache with 5m TTL.
testing_steps: 1) enable ONCALL_HINTS=true in staging; 2) trigger a sample pager with SLO id; 3) verify compact snippets are included in oncall message and hint suggests expected diagnose steps; 4) run unit-tests and integration-tests as in CI workflow.
notes: No customer-facing behavior change unless feature flag enabled. Kept defensive defaults and gated rollout.
